articles.title: A 12-Year-Old Coder Built a Robot to Save His Endangered Language
articles.summary: Holden Hoy, 12, built a shoulder-mounted robot that speaks Anishinaabemowin, a Native language with fewer than 10,000 U.S. speakers. His mentor, Danielle Boyer, invented the SkoBot to make language learning feel like play, not homework.

articles.title: Burnham Refuses to Vouch for Trump, Vows to Put Britain First
articles.summary: In his first major interview as PM, Andy Burnham declined to say he trusts President Trump, stating he’ll voice disagreements when needed. He also ruled out an early election and wouldn’t commit to a 3% GDP defense spending target by 2030.

articles.title: Decoding AI Labels: What ‘Open-Source’ Really Means for Models Like LLaMa and DeepSeek
articles.summary: AI models are labeled ‘open’ or ‘closed,’ but the reality is murkier. ‘Open-weight’ models like Meta’s LLaMa share trained parameters but not training data. True open-source AI, per the Open Source Initiative, requires releasing the data too — a massive challenge.
